name: telegram_channel_alert
description: Posts formatted text and photo alerts to a Telegram group or channel, splitting messages around the 4096 character limit and handling the smaller 1024 character caption limit, with severity badges.

chat_id.description: Channel or group: @username, a bare username, or the numeric id (channels usually look like -100XXXXXXXXXX).

message.description: Alert text; split automatically past 4096 characters.

photo_url.description: Optional image URL; when set the alert posts as a photo with the caption.

photo_caption.description: Caption for the photo; falls back to message.

severity.description: info, warning or critical, prefixed as a badge.

parse_mode.description: HTML (default), MarkdownV2, Markdown, or omitted for plain text.

bot_token.description: Bot token; falls back to the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable.
